ul.li: Core does not reference ASP.NET Core or EF Core.
Request/response DTOs live only in Core (UseCases or Account Contracts).
Core API interfaces live in Contracts.
The server exposes no HttpClient surface.
Entity configurations live under feature Persistence namespaces and target Core domain entities.
